column1: # pi-6 Yamaka Pāli→Vietnamese plain termbase, builder decisions 2026-11-22. CITATION FORM (pi-1 … pi-5 rule): noun headwords with their nominaliser as used alone; stems, compound members, adjectives and predicates bare; tense words only where the tense is the point; «có» / «điều» / «khi» dropped unless part of the meaning («sau khi» kept for the absolutive -tvā); person names with their head noun; the unbroken form over a gapped « … » form. Yamaka variants: the term is the positive, unbroken, plain form of the keyword itself (past «đã X», future «sẽ X»; «chưa từng X», «sẽ … X» and «vẫn …» are polarity / no ca renderings of the same form; a fused negative keyword keeps its «không»: nappajahissanti «sẽ không dứt bỏ» = nuppajjissati). Plane-beings: a genitive plural being (-ānaṃ) takes its head noun «chúng sinh trong cõi X»; the plane itself (accusative, locative, nominative) is «cõi X»; Itaresaṃ alone «người khác». Titles: the heading form «Các cặp câu hỏi về …» (closers <X>yamakapāḷi stay lower case).
